name: iOS Simulator
description: Adds the workflow and manual entry for Cindy's Host-owned embedded iOS Simulator. WDA, Native H.264, Native HID, lifecycle, recovery, and fallback remain managed by Cindy Host.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants to build, launch, inspect, or interact with an iOS app in Cindy's embedded simulator rather than opening the external Simulator.app.
author: Cindy
